title: Plan your website
funFact: Coding agents like Pipo Code can write the code for you, and you're still the designer. Next, Pipo Code builds the home page!
postcard: Kai and Pipo at a laptop showing a cheerful website about Nugget the hamster: {answer}
situation: Hi Kai! Want to make a website? I can help you plan it.
facts: 🌻 Nugget is 2 and loves sunflower seeds
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. Help with what they ask, in simple words. When you plan a website, write one line per page.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Plan a website about my hamster, Nugget
pieces.text: Plan a website about my hamster, Nugget.

slots.label: What does Pipo Code need to know?

pieces.label: 3 pages: home, photos, fun facts
pieces.text: It needs 3 pages: home, photos and fun facts.

pieces.label: Nugget is 2 and loves sunflower seeds
pieces.text: Nugget is 2 years old and loves sunflower seeds.

pieces.label: Only use my first name, Kai
pieces.text: Only use my first name, Kai.

pieces.label: Make it the coolest site in the universe!
pieces.text: Make it the coolest site in the universe!
pieces.tip: "The coolest site" doesn't tell Pipo Code what to build. Pages and facts do.

flaws.hint: "Make me a website" doesn't say what it's about.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's about Nugget, so it planned some other website.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code which pages you want.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know your pages, so it picked its own.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code anything about Nugget.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know about Nugget, so there's nothing special about Nugget on the site.

lesson: Pipo Code builds what you describe. Give it the pages and the facts.
